items.item: NXP SC667506WKK (main MCU; second line 1N00R, third line ZRAA2635A)
items.identity: NXP customer-specific ('SC' = custom build) S12 MagniV S12ZVMC256 — 16-bit S12Z motor-control MCU with integrated 6-channel MOSFET gate-driver unit (GDU), CAN PHY, 256 KB flash. Base orderable device: S912ZVMC25F1WKK. Evidence: (1) mask set 1N00R — NXP's errata S12ZVMC256_1N00R 'applies to mask 1N00R for these products: S912ZVMC256'; (2) suffix W = -40 to +150 °C and KK = 80 LQFP-EP, the same suffix as the standard S912ZVMC25F1WKK; (3) NXP's S12ZVM fact sheet lists 'Superchargers' as a target application.
items.package: 80-pin LQFP with exposed pad, 12 × 12 mm body (≈14 × 14 mm over the leads, 20 pins a side). NOT LQFP-100: the S12ZVMC256 is offered only in 80 LQFP-EP (NXP fact sheet). If the chip really has 25 pins a side, re-count — the mask set says S12ZVMC256, which has no 100-pin package.
